description: Reconcile the existing dashboard layout chrome (sidebar + topbar/header) to the Figma Side Menu (952:4135/952:4686) and Dashboard Header (955:4905) while PRESERVING the public API and src/config/dashboard-nav.ts usage, and keep all call sites working. This is last because it touches shared layout files consumed by the app and must not break the three (dashboard)/*/layout.tsx call sites. Depends on FEAT-001 (typography + shadow-card). Independent of FEAT-002/003/004.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. get_design_context on 952:4135 (Side Menu) + 952:4686 (Side Menu Section, Default/Selected) and 955:4905 (Header); ADAPT to tokens — never paste raw Figma code.

Grep all call sites before editing: DashboardSidebar / DashboardTopbar / DashboardShell and dashboardNav usage (src/app/[locale]/(dashboard)/{student,teacher,parent}/layout.tsx render <DashboardShell role=...>). Keep every signature unchanged.

dashboard-sidebar.tsx: keep `DashboardSidebar({ role })`, keep dashboardNav/DashboardNavItem/the iconName->LucideIcon map/usePathname/Logo and the existing `active` logic + the `dashboard` i18n namespace it reads. Restyle nav items to the Figma Side Menu: paragraph-md medium (use text-paragraph-md), icon-text gap 8 (gap-2), item radius rounded-lg (16). Selected/active = bg-primary text-primary-foreground (navy #123458 fill + inverse text/icon); default hover = subtle surface (hover:bg-sidebar-accent). Use logical properties only. Do NOT change src/config/dashboard-nav.ts shape.

dashboard-topbar.tsx (the header): align to Figma Dashboard Header (955:4905) — greeting block (organisms.dashboard.welcome or dashboard namespace), optional search reusing the SearchBar molecule, plus the existing LocaleSwitcher + ThemeToggle + UserMenu and an avatar. Keep `DashboardTopbar()` signature and keep it a Server Component composing the client controls (SearchBar/UserMenu etc. stay client as today). Replace any raw rgba shadow with the shadow-card token if one is present.
Leave dashboard-shell.tsx structure intact (still composes sidebar + topbar around main). Do NOT adopt the new dashboard organisms into these layouts (app-page integration is a later stage).
If new copy is needed, add keys to messages/en.json + messages/ar.json in sync (organisms.dashboard or the existing dashboard namespace, matching where the component reads from).
acceptance_criteria: DashboardSidebar({role}), DashboardTopbar() and DashboardShell({role,children}) keep their exact signatures; dashboard-nav.ts is unchanged in shape.
The three (dashboard)/*/layout.tsx call sites type-check and render unchanged.

Sidebar selected state is a primary (#123458) surface with inverse text/icon and radius 16; nav label is paragraph-md; all styling uses logical properties and token utilities (no left/right, no raw rgba shadow).
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run test` (79 existing + all new stay green), `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` all pass at zero errors.
verification: npm run typegen; npm run typecheck
